info.title: Conversations public (visitor) API
info.description: The REST subset a native app can call directly instead of using the hosted chat web view. Real time is Socket.IO (namespace `/ws/<workspace_id>`, see docs/REALTIME.md). Guide: docs/MOBILE-API.md. Generated; do not edit.

get.summary: Widget configuration for an embed token (`x-api-key`, `Origin`)

parameters.name: x-api-key
parameters.description: The embed token (public by design; it is in every website's HTML)

parameters.name: x-hosted-chat
parameters.description: Native apps and same-origin pages send `1` (and no Origin) with a token that has the hosted chat enabled

post.summary: What a call link's page shows before the visitor agrees to join: who is on the other end (the AI assistant with its label, or the team), the kind and the expiry. A link that cannot be used (unknown, expired, revoked, used, in use on another device) answers `404 LINK_UNAVAILABLE`, always the same; failures are throttled and escalate into an IP block

post.summary: Answer a form card the server put in the thread (name, email, phone, custom fields, consent). Validated here: email syntax, phone parsed to E.164 with the picked `country`, name charset; `422 INVALID_FORM` with per-field `errors`; a card is answered once (`409 ALREADY_ANSWERED`). An email or phone that already belongs to another contact is kept as unverified and never merges that contact's history

embedToken.name: x-api-key
embedToken.description: Embed token `cvt_...`. Requests from a native app have no browser Origin; use the hosted chat's origin rules or a token created for the app (docs/MOBILE-API.md#tokens-and-origin).

RateLimited.description: Rate limited. `Retry-After` (seconds) and `RateLimit` and `X-RateLimit-*` headers say when to retry.
